documents.text: KEDA scales each agent on the num_pending of its JetStream durable consumer; the executor also scales on CPU at 60% of its request. Cluster Autoscaler adds a worker when pods stay Pending, up to 2 workers.
The TASKS stream holds tasks.> and agent.> subjects with interest retention, discard=new limits and a dead-letter subject tasks.dead. Each agent has one durable consumer.
The llm-gateway retries upstream calls with jitter, opens a circuit breaker after repeated 429/5xx and degrades live tasks to fake-llm marking degraded=true.
Live LLM spend is bounded by three barriers: X-Demo-Token admission, a 3 USD gateway budget in NATS KV and a 5 USD provider project limit. Load and attack tests use fake-llm and spend zero tokens.

Each task is a Dapr Workflow instance persisted in Redis. The model decides the next tool call; the workflow delegates via pub/sub and waits for the completion event, up to 6 decisions, resuming after pod failures.
Agents run distroless and non-root with read-only filesystems. Dapr mTLS protects sidecar traffic, NetworkPolicies default-deny the apps namespace and only the gateway may egress to 443.
Services expose Prometheus metrics, JSON logs with task_id and OTLP traces to Alloy and Grafana Cloud. One task equals one trace. The gateway also exports live LLM calls to LangSmith over OTLP.
GitHub Actions builds distroless images, scans them with Trivy and promotes the image tag in gitops/. Argo CD is the only actor that changes the cluster.
